title: NBN POI 3RWO (Ringwood) 3LIL (Lilydale) NNI Rehoming
current_summary: Scheduled maintenance on NBN services at the Ringwood (3RWO) and Lilydale (3LIL) POIs in Melbourne to migrate services to a new router at Exhibition Exchange. Short interruptions of up to 2 hours were expected during the window 12:00 AM–2:00 AM AEST on Saturday, 8 August 2026. The maintenance window has concluded; no further impact is expected.

updates.content: We carried out scheduled maintenance affecting NBN services delivered via the Ringwood (3RWO) and Lilydale (3LIL) POIs in Melbourne. The work was scheduled for Saturday, 8 August 2026 between 12:00 AM and 2:00 AM AEST to move services to a new router. Some customers may have experienced short interruptions during this time. The maintenance window has concluded. If you are still experiencing issues, please restart your modem or router and contact our support team.
